schema.name: GitGuardianSecretIncidents_CL
schema.description: GitGuardian secret incidents and remediation lifecycle data.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Time the incident was last triggered.

columns.name: LastTriggeredAt
columns.description: Time the incident was last triggered.

columns.name: TriggeredAt
columns.description: Time the incident was initially triggered.

columns.name: SecretHash
columns.description: GitGuardian hash of the detected secret.

columns.name: HasMySecretLeakedHash
columns.description: HasMySecretLeaked hash of the detected secret.

columns.name: GitGuardianUrl
columns.description: URL of the incident in GitGuardian.

columns.name: IsRegression
columns.description: Indicates whether the incident is a regression.

columns.name: AssigneeEmail
columns.description: Email address of the assigned member.

columns.name: IgnorerId
columns.description: Identifier of the member who ignored the incident.

columns.name: IgnorerApiTokenId
columns.description: API token that ignored the incident.

columns.name: ResolverId
columns.description: Identifier of the member who resolved the incident.

columns.name: ResolverApiTokenId
columns.description: API token that resolved the incident.

columns.name: IsSecretRevoked
columns.description: Indicates whether the secret was revoked.

columns.name: SeverityRuleId
columns.description: Identifier of the severity rule applied to the incident.

columns.name: IsVaulted
columns.description: Indicates whether the secret is stored in a vault.

columns.name: DestinationTickets
columns.description: External remediation tickets linked to the incident.

columns.name: Occurrences
columns.description: Secret occurrence details returned by GitGuardian.

columns.name: ConnectionName
columns.description: Friendly name of the connector instance.
